eligibility_summary: Potential class members: US and territory residents who paid for qualifying insured prescriptions at Kroger-owned pharmacies between December 9, 2018 and August 23, 2026. Receipt keywords alone do not establish eligibility. Claim identification and proof requirements depend on administrator records and claimed spending; read the official notice before filing.
name: Kroger $17M Prescription Drug Pricing Settlement
typical_payout_range: Variable pro rata payment based on qualifying prescription spending, valid claims and court approval. No individual payout or timing is guaranteed.

eligibility_summary: US purchasers of VSL#3 for personal use between June 1, 2016 and June 19, 2019. The official notice describes household limits, proof/notice-credential rules and exclusions. Receipt keywords alone do not establish eligibility.
name: VSL#3 Probiotic $20M False Advertising Settlement
typical_payout_range: $20 per qualifying unit before possible adjustments. No-proof household claims are generally limited to one unit; proof or notice credentials may support more units under the official notice, up to 40. Payments may increase or decrease based on available funds.

typical_payout_range: Up to $5 (no documentation) or up to $10 (with documentation), subject to pro rata reduction based on total claims.
